induction_argument: Initial fresh base financial state, targets, source, costs, funding and account class are identical. Until the first true trigger, locks/events are empty and inherited schedule/attempt/advance_day are base-identical. At every eligible original-path hook, READY predicate is false or NOT_READY takes no protection action. Thus no first differing financial transition exists, by chronological prefix induction. Metadata and coverage differ; snapshot bytes and candidate genuine hashes are not claimed equal.
same_clock_hook_argument: Native marks are updated before funding_through(close,True). All earlier same-clock funding callbacks skip while another event remains. The final event callback and subsequent explicit close callback see the exact q/E stored in that completed close row; duplicate false evaluations have no financial side effects. Funding callbacks using a stale mark skip because close_us != stamp. Halt/zero-position cases cannot schedule protection.
